name: drawer-action
title: DrawerAction
description: A single action in a BottomDrawer footer: plain, form-submit, or tap-again-confirm.
docs: Modal actions belong in the drawer's sticky footer, never in scrollable content. Lay them out in an even row, most-destructive leftmost and primary rightmost: Delete, Reset, Cancel, Save. A Save uses type="submit" with form="<id>" so it can submit a form rendered in drawer content, and stays disabled until the form is dirty and valid.
